description: Buyer: locks the payment. Seller: locks the bond (if the deal has one). Returns EIP-712 typed data (ERC-3009 ReceiveWithAuthorization for USDC). Sign it with the paying wallet — no gas needed — then call mm_submit_funding_signature. Valid for 2 hours.

payer_address.description: The wallet that holds the USDC and will sign

token.description: Your private deal token (from mm_create_deal or your deal link ?k=...)

name: mm_get_funding_request
title: Get the message to sign to lock money
